programme.desc: S17 E3 — Home Sweet An 8-year-old girl dies in the explosion of an Upper East Side brownstone; detectives determine faulty wiring is to blame, but with little evidence it is difficult to prove the case.
programme.title: Law & Order

programme.desc: S17 E5 — Public Service Homicide A man (A.J. Handegard) dies after being identified on a newsmagazine programme that had been luring suspected paedophiles by having staff members pose as young girls.
programme.title: Law & Order

programme.desc: S9 E7 — Devil's Triangle When the husband of Gibbs' and Fornell's ex-wife is kidnapped, the NCIS team partners up with the FBI to investigate.
programme.title: NCIS

programme.desc: S9 E8 — Engaged, Part 1 While investigating the crash of a military plane that was transporting caskets, the NCIS team discover a discrepancy with the DNA remains.
programme.title: NCIS

programme.desc: S9 E9 — Engaged The search into the disappearance of a marine lieutenant continues, as the NCIS team tracks them down to Afghanistan. Meanwhile, Tony's deepest fear resurfaces and Gibbs has to go through memories of his past again.
programme.title: NCIS

programme.desc: S3 E1 — The Beast of Wall Street When someone goes on a superhuman rampage, Cat and Vincent jeopardise their newfound normality to try to solve the case; Tess accuses J.T. of endangering his recovery; J.T. struggles to understand how he's still alive.
programme.title: Beauty and the Beast

programme.desc: S3 E2 — Primal Fear Vincent and Cat deal with their rapidly changing relationship when they move in together; when J.T. tries to impress Tess' brothers, he discovers that there may be a side effect to the medication he received; Heather returns with an announcement.
programme.title: Beauty and the Beast

programme.desc: S1 E9 — Stocks & Bondage An investment analyst is found hanged in her bedroom and the unit explore her sordid sexual past in order to uncover her murderer's identity.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S1 E10 — Closure A rape victim turns to the unit for help, but lack of evidence prevents them from arresting the offender.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S26 E12 — Calculated When a high school principal busts a student for sexting, the SVU uncovers a sinister case of distribution concerning hundreds of underage students; Silva pleads for leniency for a suspect she believes is innocent.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S26 E13 — Extinguished Velasco teams up with a community security guard eager to prove his mettle to find a suspect in the assault of two teens.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S26 E16 — Let Me Bring Pardon The doctor of a comatose woman calls SVU when he discovers his patient is pregnant; Benson must convince the family to reject magical thinking and look at the facts.
programme.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit

programme.desc: S2026 E45 — Episode 45 A daily round-up of showbiz news and gossip from around the world, focusing on celebrities, movies, music and entertainment.

programme.desc: S33 E11 — Betrayal and Baby Formula A woman makes a desperate attempt to frame her friend right in front of deputies; a driver's assortment of containers raises some questions; a man in possession of a stolen truck insists that his friend is the one at fault.
programme.title: Cops

programme.desc: S8 E7 — Crazy Train Callum undertakes a tough undercover assignment when an NSA agent disappears while tracking a dangerous ISIS cell.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E8 — Parallel Resistors The team uncovers a sinister connection when a grad student who's inventing a high-tech weapon for the Navy is attacked.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S6 E20 — Down the Rabbit Hole Thomas Wilder, a serial killer, taunts Danny by attaching a note addressed to him to his latest victim.
programme.title: Blue Bloods

programme.desc: S6 E21 — The Extra Mile Anthony and Erin try to track down an important witness and convince him to testify after he flees in fear of his life.
programme.title: Blue Bloods

programme.desc: S6 E22 — Blowback Frank must deal with public outrage after an officer who was involved in a controversial shooting is acquitted.
programme.title: Blue Bloods

programme.desc: S8 E9 — Glasnost Callen is placed in a tough situation when his father is linked to a terrible case of radiation poisoning.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E11 — Tidings We Bring NCIS looks into the disappearance of a Navy lieutenant commander who is working on foreign cyber threats with the NSA; the team celebrates the holidays.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E12 — Kulinda When a navy reservist is killed, Sam is sent undercover at a private security firm, which has links to several crime organisations.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E13 — Hot Water The team are left scrambling for answers when the mole compromises the NCIS. Planted evidence leads to Callen, Sam, Granger and Deeks's arrests.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E14 — Under Siege The mole kidnaps one of the NCIS agents. Plus, the team are left completely in the dark when Hetty goes rogue.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E15 — Payback Tensions in the team run high as one agent undergoes torture from the mole. Meanwhile, another uncovers a shocking betrayal.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.desc: S8 E16 — Old Tricks While investigating the kidnapping of a retirement home resident, the NCIS team discovers a pair of con artists who go from home to home scamming the elderly out of their money; Callen confronts his father on his illegal activity.
programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles

programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S12 E14 — Tall John's House The final visit is to Robin and Liza's Georgian mansion Tall John's House in the Brecon Beacons. At dinner the guests gush over their new friendships, but Vicky doesn't share their feelings.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S12 E15 — Payment Day It's the final day of the competition and the B&B owners are meeting for the last time to settle some scores. The White Hart Hotel is up first and management team Clarky and Katie want to park the issue of paying for their car park.
programme.title: Four in a Bed

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Episode 6 Following Sister Jen's night shift, which kick-starts as a 35-year-old stabbing victim, Colin Richards, is rushed in by ambulance with injuries to his lung, arm and liver. He's accompanied by his 19-year-old girlfriend, Esther, who was lying in bed next to him when they were awoken at gunpoint. While Esther cradles her boyfriend in Resus, Jen tends to Nancy Shirley, 86, who has spent her life alone and fell over at home.
programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.desc: S1 E8 — Episode 8 John, 77, has been sent to A&E with his wife Brenda after a routine health screening revealed a potentially deadly 'Triple A' - abdominal aortic aneurysm - a dramatic swelling of the main artery that could burst at any moment, making him a 'walking time bomb'. The only option is major surgery. Meanwhile, 92-year-old widow Eileen has been brought into hospital after falling and spending the night on the floor.
programme.title: 24 Hours in A&E

programme.desc: S4 E1 — Episode 1 Doctors Scott Taylor and Jonathan Papson help a pregnant woman who's been badly injured in a high-speed traffic crash.
programme.title: The Emergency Ward

programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Backyard Cabrito Asado in Texas Jess joins her friend Javi in his backyard, where he welds custom cooking contraptions, including an asado cross they use to cook cabrito together.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Texas A&M Meat Science Experiment In windy Canyon, Texas, Jess visits West Texas A&M, where she interacts with a cloned cow, participates in a blind meat tasting experiment, and helps teach us how to break down a carcass into the cuts we see in the grocery store.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Braving Wisconsin's Cannibal Sandwich Jess embarks on a road trip across Wisconsin with her good friend Kaitlin, stopping for a cannibal sandwich and a famous sausage from Usinger's in Milwaukee.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Fall Turkey Hunting with a Texas Game Warden It's not every day that you get to hunt alongside a game warden, but for this trip, Jess does just that when she meets up with her friend Chris to do some fall turkey hunting.
programme.title: Hardcore Carnivore

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Live Fire Whole Trout Pat Martin heads to the Cherokee National Forest for a day of fly-fishing with an old friend, and to cook up their fresh catch over the campfire.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E04 — The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Greek Spit Roast Lamb Pat Martin links up with his pal, Bill Darsinos, to enjoy a tradition from the heart of Bill's Greek culture when they cook a whole lamb on a spit roast.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E07 — Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E09 — Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Barbecued Pork Steak Pat Martin travels to Gainesboro, Tennessee to visit a free-range hog farm, learn about their operations, and grill up a less desired, but no less delicious, cut of hog - pork steaks.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Red Curry Braised Pork with Mustard Greens Pat Martin is in the frozen tundra of Minnesota to visit his new friend, Chef Yia Vang. They brave the cold and break nearly-frozen ground to barbecue a pig's head in the earth.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S02 E07 — Spearfishing off Florida's Emerald Coast Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.
programme.title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Roasting Hilltop Lamb in Basilicata Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Best of Salina's Land and Sea Jamie returns to cooking the food he loves the most, getting right to heart of the Italian kitchen.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Making Pizza in Naples Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Fast Paced Roman Recipes Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Italian Alps Comfort Food Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.
programme.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Tuscan Farmhouse Classics Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S05 E09 — Southern Shrimp Skewers and Asian Crispy Rice Andrew Zimmern grills beloved shrimp in two distinct ways. He starts with jumbo shrimp and country ham skewers glazed with sweet-hot pepper jelly. Then, he creates Asian-inspired shrimp, served over crispy basmati rice and a complex sambal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel! Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E09 — Tuna 101: Grilled, Poached and Raw Chef Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole tuna and serves it three ways: grilled, raw, and poached.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Grilled Rabbit with Panzanella Salad Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E08 — Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Yakitori-Style Skewers and Pheasant Flatbread Andrew butchers a whole pheasant to make yakitori-style skewers and a homemade flatbread, cucumber salad and a mango chutney.
programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Mexican Carne Asada Hero Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Weeknight Family Dinner Hero Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!
programme.title: Backyard BBQ Hero

programme.desc: S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E05 — The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E04 — Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.
programme.title: Barbecue: Smoke Out

Su sargento intenta convencer al capitán para volver y rescatarles a ambos, pero éste se niega, encargándoles una nueva misión. Desobedeciendo las órdenes, el sargento y sus hombres regresan al poblado.
programme.title: Rescate en Afganistán

programme.title: The fall of the order

programme.desc: For the past 2000 years, he has remained the most famous character of History. Described as a leader, as a feminist, an anarchist, a healer. But today, what do we really know about Jesus?
programme.title: In the Footsteps of Jesus

programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.
programme.title: The East

programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.
programme.title: The West

programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. programme.desc: America and Europe in 1491, and why America was discovered and not the other way around.
programme.title: Part 1

programme.desc: The true legacy of Columbus is biological, and it created one world out of two.
programme.title: Part 2

programme.desc: More than 2000 years ago the Maya built gigantic cities in the middle of the jungle of Central America. They were brilliant inventors and set standards in writing, mathematics and astronomy.
programme.title: The Maya

programme.desc: The Aztecs: Within a very short time they created a huge empire, whose metropolis was a perfectly organized floating garden city on the Mexican plateau.
programme.title: The Aztecs

programme.desc: The Incas appear out of nowhere and within a few decades their empire develops into the largest empire in the world at the time.
programme.title: The Incas

programme.desc: To many, Columbus is the man who discovered America. Yet, there had been others before him. This is their story!
programme.title: First Before Columbus

programme.desc: A German-Egyptian team is looking for traces of the largest temple of the pharaohs in the middle of Cairo and for answers as to why the sanctuary was abandoned more than 2000 years ago.
programme.title: Heliopolis - The City of the Sun

programme.desc: Ancient Greece – the cradle of modern Europe. Around 3000 years ago, the cultural foundations of western civilisation were laid right here, on the shores of the Mediterranean. It’s the birthplace of democracy, where great thinkers forged the beginnings of scientific reasoning, where theatre was turned into mass entertainment, and where the Olympic Games began. Imaginative animation, stunning visuals and an entertaining narrative combine in an extraordinary exploration of Greece and the rise of an ancient super-power that would leave a permanent mark on western society.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Greeks Changed the World

programme.desc: The Romans created one of the greatest empires in history, built with the help of an incredible army of professional legionnaires and a well-oiled political machinery. At its height, a few hundred men ruled over a fifth of mankind and an area stretching from Britain to Syria and from Gibraltar to the Euphrates. They undertook some of the most ambitious building projects of their time: endless roads, gigantic bridges and imposing aqueducts formed a complex infrastructure and left a lasting legacy. This film is a revelatory and unique journey into the world of ancient Rome.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Romans Changed the World

programme.desc: This episode explores the Vikings not as ruthless raiders but as groundbreaking seafarers, traders, and explorers. Master shipbuilders, they forged vast networks of commerce stretching from Europe to Asia and even reached the shores of America centuries before Columbus. By challenging the stereotype of violent marauders, the documentary presents the Vikings as a tolerant and skilled people whose innovations in navigation and trade reshaped medieval exploration and left an enduring mark on global history.
programme.title: The Ascent of Civilization - How the Vikings Changed the World

programme.desc: After the war, hunger and adversity shape daily life in East Germany. Many Berliners go to the countryside in search of food. In the city, a notorious gang of youths is up to no good.
programme.title: The East

programme.desc: Robbery, murder, rape. After the war, West Germany is the scene of brutal crimes. On the German-Belgian border, children risk their lives for something to eat.
programme.title: The West

programme.desc: Germany, 1945. A nation faces up to the ruins of its past. Hunger and adversity shape daily life. What lengths did people go to? Over two episodes, Crime in Post-War Germany explores this transitional phase in German history by using the examples of individual, particularly serious criminal cases. Criminal psychologists and forensics experts go in search of traces.

programme.title: Southern Hoops: A History of SEC Basketball

programme.desc: Part Seven (2011-2022) John Calipari continues the winning tradition at Kentucky with a national championship in 2012. Four years later, Pat Summitt passes away after battling early-onset Alzheimer's disease. Dawn Staley leads South Carolina to a pair of NCAA titles.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton-Geons & Dragons
programme.desc: While Ton soups up their new truck, Allen heads to an auction solo and encounters Carolyn and CJ. There he discovers LARP weaponry, a sword collection, and falconry gear, before Ton reveals their new ride: Betty.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Voodoo Moola
programme.desc: Allen & Ton hit a storage auction in Louisiana's Capitol City and quickly find themselves in trouble with the law! The guys uncover a pair of racing lawnmowers and then stumble on an antique barber chair from the early 1900s!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Dead Aim
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face-off against an auction buyer with shady bidding tactics and even more questionable fashion sense. The guys find a custom-built monowheel & a rifle designed to ward off grave robbers in the early 19th century!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Diesel Digs
programme.desc: The guys head to the industrial hub of LA to score some heavy machinery and unearth a 1981 Bobcat 743 Frontloader, one of the first powered by a diesel engine and a trench-defending WWI German Sturmtrupp helmet bashing mace.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Big Sis Ducks Out
programme.desc: Big Sis drops some bad news as the guys clash with Carolyn over a carnival unit at an auction in Long Beach. Ton and Allen unearth a Native American tomahawk, a dunk tank and a rare gun that can fire three shots at once.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Home on the Gun Range
programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Strat'ed for Cash
programme.desc: On a limited budget in the historic L.A. neighborhood of West Adams, Allen and Ton still win three lockers and find a Maui Blue Fender Stratocaster and a 1930s Schwinn bike.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Pucks for Bucks
programme.desc: The guys get stuck with a unit they didn't want and have to sort through trash to make their bottom line. They uncover glass blowing tools, autographed baseballs and a hockey puck launcher, which puts Ton in the line of fire.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Nothing But Net
programme.desc: Ton and Allen face their toughest challenge yet when two old rivals join forces. The guys dig up an off-road motorcycle and a pair of net guns, while the staff clashes with mystery shoppers back at Haff Ton Pawn.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fire in the Hole!
programme.desc: 1930s "blasting machine" dynamite detonator box; 1890s treasure chest with secret compartments. Ton smelts jewelry to forge bricks of silver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Bowling Pin Payday
programme.desc: Allen & Ton visit Ton's old stompin' ground and go head-to-head with a trash-talking auction buyer. They uncover a 19th century rifle with a matching cutlass bayonet and a mechanical bowling pinsetter from the early 1960's!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ramped Up
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go head-to-head with their former assistant, Carolyn, while Ton battles a bad back. The guys discover an automatic BB gun and, when negotiations to sell a stunt ramp go south, Allen faces a tough decision.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sin City Shootout
programme.desc: 1953 Chevy-inspired bumper car; scores of M16 30-round magazines; reproduction 1940s boardwalk photobooth; aerosol-powered spud gun potato launchers.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Wreck-Shaw
programme.desc: Allen drags a starving Ton to a weekend auction and some newbie buyers try to eat up all the profit. Will a rickshaw, a wrecking ball, and blast detonators be enough to satisfy Ton's appetite, or will the guys go home hungry?

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Early Bird Special
programme.desc: Vintage Shooting Star carnival game; professional Mixed Martial Arts octagon fighting cage.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Trading Places
programme.desc: When an injury sidelines Allen, he stays at the shop while Ton takes Big Sis to the auction and goes rogue, ignoring Allen's advice and making risky purchases that could lose the partners a boatload of cash.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Catch My Drift?
programme.desc: The guys land a custom drift car and a luxury antiques unit that could have a one-of-a-kind pilot pistol from WWI. While trying to track down the provenance of the gun, Ton's lead foot gets them into trouble at their car sale.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Whiskey Business
programme.desc: An auction in Allen's old stomping grounds triggers memories of being a "lone wolf." The guys find a set of RC race boats and when they buy a man-cave unit full of old whiskey, a night of partying leads to some tough sales.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Reel Money
programme.desc: 1970's-era Fighting Chair used for big-game fishing; military MILES "laser tag" training system.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chicago Grand Slam
programme.desc: 1984 Yamaha SS440 Snowmobile that introduced the revolutionary shock absorber suspension; rare autographed 1920s baseball glove; mint Hank Aaron signed baseball; authentic 1950s Robby the Robot collector toy.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hall of Fame Game
programme.desc: Allen heads to an auction with Elle, while Ton and Big Sis revamp the shop to help bring in more customers. Allen unearths a Ouija board and a set of antique basketballs, and goes toe-to-toe with an NBA Hall of Famer.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks
programme.desc: Military-grade Tomahawk cruise missile jet engine; century-old handcrafted wild west cowboy saddle; 1960s high roller's gold money.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Party Gras
programme.desc: On a trip to New Orleans, Ton and Allen look to mix business with pleasure. They wage war with some locals at a tough auction, win a Mardi Gras unit that contains a confetti blaster and a modern calliope, then hit the town.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Tough as Nails
programme.desc: CJ seeks to disrupt Allen's search for serenity at a storage auction before the guy's head to a live auction to buy and sell. They uncover an unusual Marilyn Monroe statue, an industrial slip n' slide, and a bed of nails.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: To Pawn or Not To Pawn
programme.desc: On the brink of a major decision, Ton and Allen face-off with Carolyn at an auction in Covina. They win a "special effects unit" that contains big machines for crazy stunt work. The guys decide the fate of the shop.
programme.sub-title: To Pawn or Not To Pawn

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Louisiana Purchase
programme.desc: In Louisiana, Ton and Allen encounter some salty locals at a shipping crate auction, and navigate choppy waters at a boat auction. After spending a lot of cash, they find a tactical blast shield and a bass fishing boat.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Quadzilla Attacks!
programme.desc: Extreme Quadzilla ATV, the fastest 4 wheeler ever; a 1910s Remington Derringer and an 1880s Palm Squeezer pistol; revolutionary 1800s Western Electric telephone with a crank dial.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Disco and Dice
programme.desc: 1978 Williams Disco pinball machine; 1898 dice popper gambling device; talking 1990s bar top breathalyzer; deadly fishing harpoon.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Once a Pawn a Time
programme.desc: Ton and Allen discover that owning a pawn shop is way more trouble than they expected. With bills stacking up, even an antique ammo collection and some classic football helmets may not be enough to put the guys in the black.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Gang's All There
programme.desc: While out at a bar celebrating Petrie's promotion, the 14th precinct is robbed of their guns, shields, and possessions. The team then works furiously to find the perpetrators after they become the laughing stock of the entire NYPD.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Cry For Help
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are assigned to investigate a wife-beating case and discover that the victim's husband is a cop and former classmate of Lacey's. Meanwhile the team also has to find a way to charge a con man after they are forced to let him go.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: The Informant
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey run into an issue with their drug investigation when it turns out that their teenage informant is a perpetrator of the crimes himself. They are then faced with the dilemma of releasing a one criminal in order to arrest another.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Matinee
programme.desc: When a missing housewife turns up dead, her husband enlists the help of the 14th precinct to solve her murder. As Cagney and Lacey investigate, they discover that the woman is from Cagney's hometown, revealing a glimpse into Cagney's past.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Killers Dozen
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey become frustrated when a patrolman's strike forces them back into uniform and out onto the streets. Both women would prefer to be working on solving the homicide case they had been investigating.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Victimless Crime
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) must investigate the death of a porno film star who died during a film production. However, their investigation is hindered by the victim's costar, who is reluctant to become their star witness.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are on the search to arrest a wanted criminal who has jumped bail. As they search for the man, they run into a bounty hunter named MacGruder (guest star Brian Dennehy), who is looking for the same man, complicating matters.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Baby Brokers
programme.desc: After an infant is abandoned, Cagney and Lacey end up deep in the world of underground baby merchants. Meanwhile, Lacey seriously considers adopting the infant. Cagney deals with a new love who doesn't approve of her profession.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Partners
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) is injured while in the line of duty by a fleeing liquor store robber. While Cagney is out recovering, Lacey (Tyne Daly) must come to terms with working with a new, temporary, partner. Also starring Al Waxman and Carl Lumbly.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Choices
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey must find a new witness after their key witness in a case against a shady landlord passes away. They take to canvasing the building in question in the hopes of finding a new witness before the landlord is set free.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Child Witness
programme.desc: Cagney and Lacey are brought in by a school principal to investigate whether or not a six-year-old girl is being sexually abused. Things become more complicated when the little girl is coached by her father to recant her tale.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Heat
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are investigating vandalism at a railroad yard when Lacey is suddenly abducted by a dangerous young man (guest star Michael Madsen) escalating to a face-off between him and the SWAT Team.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Insubordination
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) find themselves investigating a cocaine dealing case that suddenly becomes much more complicated when their commanding officer turns out to be Dory McKenna (guest star Barry Primus).

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Old Debts
programme.desc: Cagney (Sharon Gless) and Lacey (Tyne Daly) are on the protection duty of a recently paroled cop killer while he awaits a new identity and is moved away. After he is murdered while under their protection, Cagney and Lacey work to find the murderer.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Fathers & Daughters
programme.desc: When a man's suicide turns out to be a murder, Cagney and Lacey must figure out who the true murderer is after the man's wife and daughter both confess to the crime. The investigation only becomes more complicated when they discover more.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Taxi Cab Murders
programme.desc: When a string of violent murders takes place, Cagney and Lacey go undercover as Taxi Cab drivers to try and find the killer. Lacey's family becomes hysterical at the prospect, fearing that Lacey will lose her life in pursuit of justice.

programme.title: Cagney & Lacey: Unusual Occurrence

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' følger du Henrik Heggheims rejse fra Stavanger til Brøndby IF. Hør om overgangen til dansk fodbold, tilværelsen på Vestegnen og de oplevelser, der har formet ham som spiller og menneske i den gule trøje.

programme.title: Dokumentar
programme.desc: Oplev et følelsesladet og nostalgisk tilbageblik på mesterskabet, ingen troede muligt. Hør historierne bag sæsonen, der kulminerede i Brøndby IF’s første triumf i 16 år – fortalt af dem, der selv var med til at skrive historien.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Bent 'Turbo' Christensen Arensøes målrige karriere i Brøndby IF. Med fem mesterskaber, to pokaltitler og tre topscorertitler skrev han sig ind i historien – både som spiller og træner.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: I sæsonpremieren af 'Legenden Fortæller' ser vi tilbage på Kim Vilforts 12 år i Brøndby IF – fra præsentationen i 1986 til den sidste kamp i 1998. Hør om de største kampe, titlerne og øjeblikkene, der gjorde ham til en af klubbens største profiler.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'All Access' kommer du helt tæt på den intense derbysejr og med bag kulisserne til kampen i Aalborg, hvor du oplever stemningen, forberedelserne og øjeblikkene, der definerede to af sæsonens mest nervepirrende opgør.

programme.title: Spillerportrætter
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spillerportrætter' møder du drengene fra Vestegnen, Clement Bischoff og Noah Nartey. Hør om deres rødder, vejen gennem ungdomsrækkerne og stoltheden ved at spille for Brøndby IF – klubben, de er vokset op med.

programme.title: Legenden fortæller
programme.desc: Morten Wieghorst sætter i dette længere interview ord på sin tid på Vestegnen, som gjorde ham til en helt særlig stikkelse i klubbens historie.

programme.title: Sportsdirektørerne
programme.desc: I første afsnit af Sportsdirektørerne møder vi tre tidligere sportsdirektører i Brøndby IF, der åbent deler deres oplevelser fra livet bag kulisserne i en af Danmarks største fodboldklubber.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I sæsonafslutningen af 'Vores Brøndby' hyldes klubben i en kærlighedserklæring. Med Rasmus Hammerich og Kim Vilfort taler panelet om, hvorfor Brøndby betyder så meget – for fans og spillere – og hvad der gør klubben helt særlig.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Marko Divkovic om skiftet fra angreb til forsvar, Daniel Wass deler sine tanker om rollen som playmaker, og Jonathan Ægidius giver et indblik i konkurrencen og kampen om pladsen mellem stængerne.

programme.title: Holdet - Tæt på
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Holdet – Tæt på' får du status fra Jesper Sørensen og spillerne Rasmussen, Kvistgaarden, Bischoff og Rajović. Hør deres refleksioner om sæsonen, præstationerne og hvad der venter forude i jagten på succes.

programme.title: Fokus
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Fokus' fortæller Frederik Alves om at gribe chancen, Mathias Kvistgaarden markerer sin milepæl med 50 kampe i gult og blåt, og Rasmus Lauritsen ser tilbage på sin startdebut i Brøndby IF-trøjen.

programme.title: Spørg Løs!
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Spørg Løs!' afslører spillerne deres bedste udebaneminder, yndlingsfilm og hvem der ville vinde Wimbledon – eller Vild med dans. Du får også svar på, hvem der er nemmest at forskrække og mest savnet i vinterpausen.

programme.title: Vores Brøndby
programme.desc: I denne episode af 'Vores Brøndby' dykker et nyt panel med Colding, Kahlenberg og Nanna Møller Karlsen ned i klubbens største kampe. Allan Ravn gæster studiet og fortæller om sit ikoniske mål mod Bayern München og de oplevelser, der har formet Brøndby.

programme.title: Udfordringen
programme.desc: I dette afsnit af 'Udfordringen' dyster spillerne i buzz-ball, fodboldgolf og straffesparkskonkurrence mellem Danmark og Norge. Der er også stil på programmet, og så kæmpes der om æren i “Tættest på midten".

O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.
programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa

programme.desc: Biografie najlepszych obrońców lat 90., którzy trwale zapisali się w historii niemieckiej ekstraklasy. Widzowie poznają życiorysy takich piłkarzy, jak: Mike Werner, Lothar Matthäus, Thomas Helmer, Matthias Sammer czy Jens Nowotny.

programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.
programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne

programme.desc: Karl-Heinz Rummenigge Biografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.
programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi

programme.desc: Szybcy napastnicy mijający obrońców niczym slalomowe tyczki to nie tylko domena ligi hiszpańskiej. W historii Bundesligi także nie brakowało świetnie wyszkolonych technicznie snajperów, którzy bez wątpienia zasługiwali na miano czarodziejów dryblingu.
programme.title: Najlepsi dryblerzy Bundesligi

programme.desc: Mecze Bayernu z Borussią Dortmund od lat nadają ton rywalizacji o mistrzostwo Niemiec. Nie inaczej będzie z Der Klassikerem numer 141, który zostanie rozegrany w ramach ósmej kolejki kampanii 2026/27. Bawarczycy i piłkarze BVB do połowy października szli łeb w łeb w wyścigu o tytuł. Ich bezpośrednie starcie na Allianz Arenie najprawdopodobniej zadecyduje o tym, który z gigantów zostanie samodzielnym liderem Bundesligi. Podopieczni Vincenta Kompany'ego mają nad Dortmundczykami przewagę psychologiczną. Znajdują się bowiem na fali trzech zwycięstw z rzędu nad Borussią. Ostatnim razem pokonali ją 2:1 w sierpniowym meczu o Superpuchar Niemiec.

programme.desc: Rossoneri znaleźli patent na derbowego rywala. Mogą się poszczycić bilansem pięciu wygranych i trzech remisów w ośmiu ostatnich konfrontacjach z Interem. Podrażnieni Nerazzurri mają świadomość, że muszą zrobić wszystko, co w ich mocy, by przerwać błędne koło i odzyskać panowanie w stolicy Lombardii. W hicie dziesiątej kolejki na pewno zmotywuje ich do tego spory ścisk panujący na szczycie tabeli Serie A. Jeśli Piotr Zieliński i spółka nie pokonają Milanu, ucieszą piłkarzy Lazio i Romy, którzy na obecnym etapie sezonu wyglądają na ich głównych konkurentów w wyścigu o scudetto.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Nintendo solo hace videojuegos, ¿cierto? ¡Falso!, la empresa japonesa ha tenido otros negocios diferentes desde su fundación, y en Expansion Pack te lo contamos. Repasamos la legendaria vida de Master Chief. Además, la retroreseña de Super Metroid.
programme.sub-title: Los inicios del gigante de los videojuegos: Nintendo

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los esports continúan creciendo cada vez más, en Expansion Pack te hablaremos al respecto. Platicamos acerca de Metal: Hellsinger, un juego ideal si lo tuyo es la acción frenética y el heavy metal; y nos ponemos mitológicos para repasar God of War.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Érase una vez, un evento de videojuegos tan grande, que todo el mundo quería estar en él nos referimos al E3, y en Expansion Pack nos pondremos nostálgicos para recordar cómo era este show. Como broche de oro, honraremos obra de Shigeru Miyamoto.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack te presentaremos un top dedicado a algunas de las interpretaciones más memorables. Repasaremos la evolución de una de las sagas más emblemáticas de Xbox: Gears of War y te contaremos todo acerca del origen de adorable Kirby.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este episodio de Expansion Pack, te diremos todo lo que debes saber acerca de la Gamescom, el evento de videojuegos más grande de Europa. Veremos a detalle la trayectoria de Lara Croft; y viajaremos al pasado para recordar al legendario Dino Crisis.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Es hora de iniciar un nuevo nivel de Expansion Pack, conoceremos cómo surge la ESRB, también veremos la evolución de la legendaria saga “Príncipe de Persia”, y echaremos un vistazo a esos juegos que fueron tan buenos que cambiaron a su género.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Los Game Awards, en Expansion Pack te volverás experto en uno de los eventos más importantes para el gaming, recordaremos al maravilloso “Pilot Wings 64”, y reconoceremos a los maestros de la música en los videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: ¿Conoces las diferencias ente Remaster, Remake y Reboot? En este episodio de Expansion Pack te las contamos. Veremos cómo “Street Fighter”, ha cambiado con el paso de los años; y sentimos el terror con las creepypastas más famosas en videojuegos.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En México también se desarrollan videojuegos en Expansion Pack, te mostramos algunos, recordamos a una leyenda del PS1, “Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver”, además, hoy conocerás a fondo al polémico Hideo Kojima y viajamos al Tokyo Game Show.
programme.sub-title: Juegos con sello: Hecho en México

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: Las leyendas eran ciertas… el Nintendo PlayStation sí existió y en Expansión Pack te contamos el chismecito. “Doom” llega para mostrarnos cómo un clásico puede evolucionar, y los juegos que terminaron siendo muy diferentes a su concepto original.

programme.title: Expansion Pack
programme.desc: En este Expansion Pack recordamos al gran “Conker’s Bad Fur Day”. También te decimos todo lo que hay que saber de Elli de “The Last of Us”, y echamos ojo a las series basadas en videojuegos que hacen honor a las franquicias.

programme.title: VG Chronicles

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: En un mundo donde los Reploids son perseguidos, Zero despierta para unirse a la resistencia contra Neo Arcadia.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: La saga Castlevania comienza con Leon Belmont en el siglo XI, quien tras perder a su amada se convierte en cazador de vampiros. Su amigo Mathias se convierte en Drácula, iniciando siglos de conflicto con los Belmont.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: Simon Belmont, tras vencer a Drácula, es maldito y debe reunir sus restos en Simon's Quest para romperla. Sus aventuras continúan en Game Boy, reforzando su legado como cazavampiros.

programme.title: VG Chronicles
programme.desc: Rondo of Blood narra cómo Richter Belmont rescata a Annette y vence a Drácula. Cuatro años después, en Symphony of the Night, Alucard investiga el regreso del castillo y la misteriosa desaparición de Richter.
programme.sub-title: Castlevania Parte 3: La sinfonia de la noche

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hace muchos anos las mascotas de videojuegos que dominaban el mercado eran 2: Mario de Nintendo y Sonic de SEGA. Esto cambio con Crash Bandicoot en PlayStation. En seguida, te contamos su historia.
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Crash Bandicoot

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar el clasico hit de 2005 desarrollado por SCE Santa Monica Studio para PlayStation 2: God of War.
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de God of War

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de contarte sobre la creacion del grupo de asesinos que juraron proteger al mundo de La Orden de los Templarios. Nada es verdad, todo esta permitido. Esta es la historia detras de: Assassin's Creed.
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Assassin's Creed

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Rare; unico, singular. Extraordinario. Dice la leyenda que su nivel era tan alto, que llego a poner celoso a mas de uno, incluso al mismisimo Shigueru Miyamoto. Por esto, es momento de ver la historia detras de Banjo Kazooie.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar la historia de desarrollo de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: En esta generacion que esta por acabar, From Software entrego un juego que, con su estilo victoriano y gotico, se distingue de sus trabajos anteriores y que rapidamente se convirtio en el futuro de muchos.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la historia detras de un emblematico FPS que cambio el genero para siempre y puso en el mercado a una compania fabricante de consolas.
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Halo- Combat Evolved

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Fortnite Battle Royale

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te narramos la creacion de una de las franquicias mas importantes para PlayStation la cual elevo a Naughty Dog a un estado de culto. Esta es la historia detras de: UNCHARTED: Drake's Fortune.
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de UNCHARTED- Drake's Fortune

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la historia de Gears of War, una emblematica franquicia de Xbox que se estreno durante la septima generacion de consolas para Xbox 360.
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Gears of War

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.sub-title: La historia detras de Pokemon rojo y Pokemon azul

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: GTA V, el juego que cambio el paradigma de diseno de Rock Star Games. Tambien, resulto siendo uno de los titulos mas exitosos para la franquicia y uno de los videojuegos mas vendidos en la historia
programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Grand Theft Auto V

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Revisamos la creacion del juego independiente desarrollado por Mojang y Markus Notch Persson que definio la ultima decada. Esta es la historia detras de Minecraft.

programme.sub-title: La historia detrás de Super Mario Kart

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
